entries: Danika can use its action to polymorph into a raven-humanoid hybrid or into a raven, or back into its human form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its human form if it dies.

trait.name: Mimicry

trait.name: Regeneration

enDerived.name: Doru
languages: the languages it knew in life

trait.name: Regeneration
entries: Doru regains 10 hit points at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 hit point and isn't in sunlight or running water. If Doru takes radiant damage or damage from {@item Holy Water (Flask)|PHB|holy water}, this trait doesn't function at the start of Doru's next turn.

trait.name: Spider Climb
entries: Doru can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

trait.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries: Doru has the following flaws:

items.name: Forbiddance
items.entry: Doru can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants.

items.name: Harmed by Running Water
items.entry: Doru takes 20 acid damage when it ends its turn in running water.

items.name: Stake to the Heart
items.entry: Doru is destroyed if a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into its heart while it is {@condition incapacitated} in its resting place.

items.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
items.entry: Doru takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks

action.name: Multiattack
entries: Doru makes two attacks, only one of which can be a bite attack.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one willing creature, or a creature that is {@condition grappled} by Doru, {@condition incapacitated}, or {@condition restrained}. {@h}6 ({@damage 1d6 + 3}) piercing damage plus 7 ({@damage 2d6}) necrotic damage. The target's hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Doru regains hit points equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its hit point maximum to 0.

action.name: Claws
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. {@h}8 ({@damage 2d4 + 3}) slashing damage. Instead of dealing damage, Doru can grapple the target (escape {@dc 13}).
